anomaly_summary_sorted['time_diff'] = anomaly_summary_sorted.groupby(['cmdb_id', 'kpi_name'])['datetime'].diff().dt.total_seconds()

# Define a gap threshold to identify consecutive intervals (e.g., 60 seconds, assuming data is per minute)
gap_threshold = 60

# Identify new fault intervals where time difference is greater than gap threshold or NaN (first record)
anomaly_summary_sorted['new_interval'] = (anomaly_summary_sorted['time_diff'] > gap_threshold) | (anomaly_summary_sorted['time_diff'].isna())

trace_df = pd.read_csv(traces_path) if traces_path else pd.DataFrame()

if not trace_df.empty:
    # Convert timestamp to datetime with UTC+8 timezone
    trace_df['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(trace_df['timestamp'], unit='s').dt.tz_localize('UTC').dt.tz_convert(tz)

    # Filter traces within failure time range
    trace_failure_df = trace_df[(trace_df['datetime'] >= start_time) & (trace_df['datetime'] <= end_time)]

    # Get faulty components from fault_summary
    faulty_components = fault_summary['cmdb_id'].unique()

    # Filter traces involving faulty components
    faulty_trace_df = trace_failure_df[trace_failure_df['cmdb_id'].isin(faulty_components)]

    # Check if 'trace_id' column exists before proceeding
    if 'trace_id' in faulty_trace_df.columns:
        # To identify the most downstream faulty component in traces:
        # Group by trace_id and find the component with the maximum timestamp (most downstream)
        downstream_faulty = faulty_trace_df.groupby('trace_id').apply(
            lambda df: df.loc[df['timestamp'].idxmax()]
        ).reset_index(drop=True)

        # Summarize trace call chains by trace_id: list of components in order of timestamp
        trace_call_chains = faulty_trace_df.sort_values(['trace_id', 'timestamp']).groupby('trace_id')['cmdb_id'].apply(lambda x: ' -> '.join(x.unique())).reset_index()
    else:
        downstream_faulty = pd.DataFrame()
        trace_call_chains = pd.DataFrame()
else:
    faulty_trace_df = pd.DataFrame()
    downstream_faulty = pd.DataFrame()
    trace_call_chains = pd.DataFrame()
